laws.rule: Under the Gunma Tanigawa-dake accident prevention ordinance, anyone climbing in the Tanigawa-dake danger zone (the rock-climbing routes) between 1 March and 30 November must lodge a climbing notification with the Tanigawa-dake Mountaineering Guidance Centre at least 10 days before, on paper or online through Compass (from 15 April 2025). Ordinary trails are outside the zone; for those, a climbing card to Gunma police is asked for. The governor can close the whole danger zone for a set period each snowmelt season.
